A header line, a related-identifier list, a citation of a capture slug, a bare mention of the registry as where a capture is seated, or the registry or its PER used as an instrument for another object is not a claim bearing on the registry. A capture's transcript quoted in a deposit is reception, not an archive claim. Volume is never a ground of removal; instances are grouped by lineage (§3.6).
